Definition: to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down
BiblicalUsage: Nachath as a verb means to sink or descend, and to press or break down, and it is used for enemies broken and bows bent. In 1 Samuel 2:10 the adversaries of the Lord shall be broken to pieces, and out of heaven He shall thunder upon them, and in 2 Samuel 22:35 David says God teaches his hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by his arms.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same word that breaks the enemy's power also bends the bow in the warrior's hand; God presses down the proud and presses strength into His own, and both are His work.
